### Q 12

### Q 14

* The teacher said that I had to obey the rules.

### Q 95

### Q 98

He gave a dress which was expensive. (Simple)

* He gave me a dress and it was expensive.
* He gave me a expensive dress.
* He gave me an expensive dress.
* He gave me a dress expensive.

## answer
C

## explanation
Simple Sentence-এ একটি মাত্র Finite Verb (gave) থাকবে এবং Adjective-টি Noun-এর পূর্বে বসবে। 'expensive' শব্দটি vowel sound দিয়ে শুরু হওয়ায় তার পূর্বে Indefinite Article 'an' বসে।
